instruction: Move the folder "downloads_Jan" into a new folder called "downloads_archive".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving folder 'downloads_Jan' into 'downloads_archive'. Evaluator verifies both: (1) folder exists at new location ~/Desktop/downloads_archive/downloads_Jan, and (2) folder no longer exists at original location ~/Desktop/downloads_Jan to ensure it was moved (not copied).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both required conditions using compound bash command
First condition: [ -d ~/Desktop/downloads_archive/downloads_Jan ] checks folder exists at destination
Second condition: [ ! -d ~/Desktop/downloads_Jan ] checks folder does NOT exist at original location (ensuring move, not copy)
Compound command with && operator correctly combines both checks - only returns 'Moved successfully.' when BOTH conditions are true
Expected value 'Moved successfully.\n' correctly matches success case output
Logic properly distinguishes between move and copy operations
No postconfig needed as file system operations are persistent
